About Us
Acme Health builds software for clinics.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain Tableau dashboards for operations leadership
- Partner with stakeholders across finance and clinical teams
- Write SQL to pull and validate data from Snowflake
- Present insights to leadership

Requirements
- 2+ years of experience in data analysis
- Advanced SQL and Tableau
- Experience building dashboards used by stakeholders
- Strong communication skills

Nice to have
- Python (pandas)
- Experience with Snowflake or dbt
- Healthcare or clinical trials background

Benefits
- Health insurance, 401k
The salary range for this role is $75,000 - $95,000.
Acme is an equal opportunity employer.
